description: This file defines a Fragment subclass called LogFragment, which contains a custom LogView for displaying log messages in an Android app. It manages view creation and updates the scroll position after log updates.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that encapsulates a LogView for displaying log data, handling view inflation, configuration, and scroll management.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets their layout parameters, styles, and padding, and assembles the view hierarchy.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets up a text change listener on the LogView to auto-scroll on new logs, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within this fragment.
